title: the move-deposit proof reads a berth chain it builds itself
intention: test_deposit_survives_a_move.py reads a berth chain it builds itself, and its corpus tooth measures a fixture corpus beside whatever corpus this box holds, so it reads the same on a box that never charted.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: the proof names CONSTRAIN_BERTH=/home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/constrain-20260817T212124-e0bc2bbadd77.json and globs that directory for its corpus tooth; akienasus has charted nothing, the directory does not exist, and tooth 1 reds with 'constrain_ref ... is not a berthed packet on disk'.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box) and Law 5 (berths are instance-space, so a class-space proof cannot assume one).
how: Write a scratch orient berth ({intent: ...}) and constrain berth ({bounds, intent_ref}) into the proof's tmp, and point base_packet's constrain_ref at it. The corpus tooth joins the live glob to a fixture corpus: one survey berthed by write_survey over the scratch chain holding MOVES_FROM, judged under MovedWorld(forwarded=True), and asserts that fixture berth is counted rescued.

clauses.claim: the proof is green on akienasus, which holds no ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets
the corpus tooth measures at least one berth on every box and counts the fixture berth rescued, so removing the deposit tolerance reds it

decisions.text: D1: the constrain berth is a scratch chain in tmp; the corpus tooth adds a fixture corpus beside the live glob.

measured.saw: ls: cannot access '/home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets': No such file or directory; the proof red at test_the_fixture_is_one_the_writer_admits
measured.how: ls on akienasus; bin/cairn test over the proof
